units.source_text: 当时，我所看到的先生和夫人的关系，大致就是这样，只有一次例外。

en.t: At that time, the relationship between Sensei and his wife as I saw it was roughly as I have described, with only one exception.

units.source_text: 有一天，我像往常那样站在先生家玄关外，

en.t: One day, as usual, I was standing outside the entrance of Sensei's house,

units.source_text: 正准备叫门时，听到客厅里有人说话。

en.t: and just as I was about to call out, I heard people talking in the sitting room.

units.source_text: 仔细一听，那不是一般的聊天，很像是争吵的声音。

en.t: When I listened closely, it was not ordinary conversation; it sounded very much like an argument.

units.source_text: 因为先生家的客厅紧挨着玄关，我站在格子门前，至少听得出是争吵声，

en.t: Since Sensei's sitting room was right next to the entrance, as I stood before the lattice door I could at least tell that the voices were arguing,

units.source_text: 而且可以肯定，其中那个不时提高嗓门的男人是先生。

en.t: and I could be certain that the man among them who raised his voice from time to time was Sensei.

units.source_text: 由于对方的声音比先生的低，听不出来是谁，但总觉得像是夫人，好像还哭了。

en.t: Because the other person's voice was lower than Sensei's, I could not tell who it was, but I had the feeling it was his wife, and she seemed to be crying.

units.source_text: 我不知道发生了什么事情，站在大门外犹豫了片刻，就决定不叫门了，径自回了住处。

en.t: Not knowing what had happened, I hesitated for a moment outside the front door, then decided not to call out and went straight back to my lodging.

units.source_text: 我心里突然涌起一股奇妙的不安，连书也看不下去了。

en.t: A strange uneasiness suddenly rose in my heart, and I could no longer even read.

units.source_text: 约莫过了一小时，先生来我住处的窗下喊我的名字。

en.t: About an hour later, Sensei came beneath the window of my lodging and called my name.

units.source_text: 我惊讶地打开窗户，先生在下面对我说：“去散散步吧。”

en.t: Surprised, I opened the window, and Sensei said to me from below, "Let's go for a walk."

units.source_text: 我掏出还裹在腰带里的表一看，已经八点多了。

en.t: I took out the watch that was still wrapped in my sash and looked at it; it was already past eight.

units.source_text: 我回来后，没有换衣服，还穿着裙裤，所以很快便出门了。

en.t: Since I had not changed clothes after coming back and was still wearing my hakama, I went out at once.

units.source_text: 那天晚上，我同先生一起喝了啤酒。

en.t: That evening, I drank beer with Sensei.

units.source_text: 先生原本没什么酒量，而且喝到一定程度还没有醉的话，他也不会非要喝醉为止。

en.t: Sensei could not drink much to begin with, and if he had drunk a certain amount without getting drunk, he would not force himself to keep drinking until he was.

units.source_text: 先生不是那种喜欢逞能的人。

en.t: Sensei was not the sort of person who liked to show off his endurance.
"Not today," Sensei said with a wry smile.
"Are you feeling down?" I asked worriedly.
